scope: L01-S004 original Figure 1. Source-scoped diagram geometry and separate author prose; not W/L bridge or physical theory verification.

source_visual_observation.claim: The W roundel shows a horizontal line apparently meeting the table left boundary near the seam between the two left-chiral rows; the circled g appears below colored columns and visually separate at screenshot resolution.

source_prose_separate.description: W acts on left-chiral fermion doublets, g on red/green/blue quark triplets, B on hypercharge assignments; these are the author's prose and do not independently define source ink stroke edges.

synthetic_geometry.domain: Closed unit rectangles [c,c+1] x [r,r+1] on a synthetic 4 by 4 lattice
synthetic_geometry.demonstrated_nonuniqueness: Two closed cells touch an outer row-seam endpoint; choosing a nonempty subset gives 3 projections. Four cells touch an interior cross; 15 projections. Identical geometric data do not force a unique physical field action.
synthetic_geometry.nonimplication: Synthetic grid geometry does NOT establish the actual source stroke endpoint, glyph identity, author convention, hyperedge meaning or physical action.
